scope: Remaining encounter and optional activity instructions, including Sunscar caravan and First Pact
NPC reward claims and clan boss announcement
Battle, save, and paused-service recovery messages
Menus and status labels that exposed internal implementation terms
method: Reviewed remaining player-facing copy by system after excluding previously audited story, item, and jutsu catalogs. Followed factual claims through the existing predicates, reward handlers, and response branches. Internal developer diagnostics, identifiers, and lore names were excluded from plain-language replacement. Existing game mechanics and story facts were preserved.

inventory.note: Discovery inventory includes names and internal strings; it is not a count of visible lines or a claim that every candidate required revision.

summary.productionStructureCheck: Passed: TypeScript AST structure and JSON structure unchanged after ignoring text values.

factualCorrections: Explore achievements count repeated Explore actions, not distinct sectors.
Honor Seal achievements require holding a balance, not lifetime earnings.
Endless Tower achievement counts wave victories, not completed runs.
Hollow Gate run achievements count recorded extractions and forfeits rather than only successful clears. They do not promise that every automatic death path counts.
World guide distinguishes the 500 carried-ryo bandit toll with no HP loss from other hostile road Flee costs.
Clan Boss parties allow up to four players.
Gambler practice card matches do not pay ryo; removed the earlier greeting that promised it.
Caravan cargo penalties reduce current cargo, not capacity.
Locked-door trap defeat is caused by HP damage, not chakra loss.
An unconfirmed door response cannot guarantee that a Shrine Key was not spent.

build.serverCompilation: Completed in .tmp/final-text-build.log before client build began; final client rebuilt separately.

fullSuite.note: Two stale wording expectations found in the first complete run were aligned with the revised recovery and boss-health copy, then the full suite was rerun.

coverage: World guide toll and Flee instructions
Guide reader navigation and responsive tables
First Pact concession recovery and round reset, including WebGL fallback
Bandit toll with sufficient and insufficient carried ryo
Logbook, Training, Jutsu Training, Missions, Clan, Hospital, Pets, Pet Ladder

strictCombatLayout.note: Five configurations passed initially. DPR 1.25 hit a pre-existing immediate image-read race: the failure screenshot showed the loaded enemy sprite. The test now polls for successful image load without weakening the requirement; its targeted rerun passed.

visualInspection: Mobile world guide including road encounter costs
Mobile Academy reward instructions and dummy incident

revisions.before: A hostile encounter can stop you with a Fight or Flee choice. Fleeing costs half your current HP, rounded down without knocking you out, and 10% of carried ryo up to the discharge cost for your level. Neither option takes banked ryo.
